summary: Completed comprehensive testing of new Rapports page and Settings Notifications tab features. All 14 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend features working correctly including Rapports page with KPIs, charts, and exports, plus Settings Notifications tab with Twilio SMS configuration status and notification switches.
critical_code_review_comments: Rapports Page: Well-implemented with 4 KPIs, Evolution du CA chart, Tunnel de conversion, Meilleurs clients, and Résumé sections
Settings Notifications Tab: Properly shows Twilio configuration status with 'Configuré' badge and missing phone number alert
CSV Export: All export endpoints working correctly (devis, factures, clients, interventions)
Period Selector: Working with Ce mois/Ce trimestre/Cette année options
